Copy-pasting between systems is one of the most common hidden costs we see in growing businesses.

Last week we asked which time sink hits hardest. Here's a practical way to fix the copy-paste problem without a big project:

→ Map the route: where the data starts, where it ends, who moves it today
→ Measure it for a week: how often each hop happens and how long it takes
→ Check existing integration points: APIs, webhooks, built-in connectors, scheduled exports
→ Automate one hop first, with a log of every transfer and an alert on failure
→ Run it in parallel with the manual process before switching over

The takeaway: start with the busiest hop, not the whole system.

If you'd like a second opinion on where to start: https://xenovasolutions.com/contact

No-show follow-up, the way I build it in n8n.

My poll last week was quiet, so I picked the one that costs appointment businesses the most empty slots: clinics first, but salons, studios and repair shops have the same problem.

1. Trigger on the booking status changing to no_show (a webhook, not a daily sweep)
2. Send a kind message with the rebook link. No guilt, no fees.
3. Wait 3 days
4. Check the booking system. Already rebooked? Stop. Otherwise, one gentle follow-up.

Step 4 is the one most builds skip, and it's the one that stops patients getting nagged.
